name: Pratt Woodworks
old_description: At Pratt Woodworks, we source our lumber from local mills and woodcutters who focus their business on milling trees that have fallen naturally or been removed with purpose. Our goal is to preserve the integrity of the wood and create beautiful, sustainable pieces that last for generations. Only the highest qualities of natural hardwoods are used to create your one-of-a-kind piece of furniture.
